parameters.query:
with candidate as materialized (
  select
    ci.content_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.category,
    ci.target_duration_seconds,
    ci.source_payload_json,
    s.narration_script,
    coalesce(s.raw_response_json->'scene_guidance_json', '[]'::jsonb) as scene_guidance_json
  from content_items ci
  join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
  where ci.status = 'script_complete'
  order by ci.updated_at asc
  limit 1
), claim as (
  update content_items ci
  set status = 'directing',
      updated_at = now()
  where ci.content_id = (select content_id from candidate)
    and ci.status = 'script_complete'
  returning ci.content_id
)
select
  c.content_id,
  c.title,
  c.category,
  c.target_duration_seconds,
  c.source_payload_json,
  c.narration_script,
  c.scene_guidance_json
from candidate c
join claim cl on cl.content_id = c.content_id;

insert into directors (
  content_id,
  voice_role,
  tts_delivery,
  global_visual_style,
  visual_strategy,
  global_pacing,
  global_music_direction,
  director_json,
  generation_model
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  nullif('{{$json.voice_role_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.tts_delivery_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.global_visual_style_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.visual_strategy_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.global_pacing_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.global_music_direction_sql}}', ''),
  '{{$json.director_json_sql}}'::jsonb,
  nullif('{{$json.generation_model_sql}}', '')
)
on conflict (content_id) do update set
  voice_role = excluded.voice_role,
  tts_delivery = excluded.tts_delivery,
  global_visual_style = excluded.global_visual_style,
  visual_strategy = excluded.visual_strategy,
  global_pacing = excluded.global_pacing,
  global_music_direction = excluded.global_music_direction,
  director_json = excluded.director_json,
  generation_model = excluded.generation_model,
  generated_at = now()
returning content_id, voice_role, generated_at;

update content_items
set status = 'directed',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Director Contract SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, title, status, updated_at;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Director Contract SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  'wf_director_contract',
  'success',
  now(),
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Director Contract SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'generation_model', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Director Contract SQL Values"].json["generation_model_sql"]}}', ''),
    'voice_role', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Director Contract SQL Values"].json["voice_role_sql"]}}', ''),
    'scene_count', {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Director Contract SQL Values"].json["scene_count_sql"]}},
    'cost', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Director Contract SQL Values"].json["cost_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
